decks.notes: The main focus of this Aggro Dimir Tempo deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong tempo advantage. The deck includes hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, efficient removal like Fatal Push, and countermagic like Force of Will to control the board. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage, while creatures like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf pressure the opponent. The deck also includes tempo cards like Daze to keep its momentum. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and maintain control of the game tempo.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble and protect The Fantasticar combo, which involves combining Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Urza's Bauble, and Mishra's Bauble to generate a loop that generates mana and draws cards. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor to slow down opponents, as well as cards like Kappa Cannoneer and Loki, God of Mischief for additional control and utility. The goal is to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents by leveraging the synergy between different combo pieces and control elements.

The primary strategy of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get out powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield through the use of Show and Tell and Omniscience. By using spells like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Force of Will for card selection and protection, the deck aims to set up its combo pieces while controlling the opponent's resources. Additionally, cards like Stock Up, Veil of Summer, and Spell Pierce provide additional protection and disruption. With the right setup, the deck can overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and game-winning plays.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal. It aims to apply pressure early with efficient creatures like Murktide Regent and Cori-Steel Cutter while controlling the board with cards like Force of Will and Unholy Heat. The deck also has card advantage engines such as Mishra's Bauble and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to keep the pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck seeks to tempo out opponents by playing aggressively while disrupting their strategy.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to aggressively control the board with powerful creatures like Guide of Souls, Ocelot Pride, and Voice of Victory while disrupting the opponent with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Static Prison. The deck also utilizes land destruction with Wasteland and creature removal with Swords to Plowshares to maintain board advantage. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides additional support by creating tokens and pumping up creatures. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy while controlling the battlefield.

The deck focuses on utilizing lands as a resource to control the game, with cards like Life from the Loam to recycle key lands and disrupt the opponent's mana base with Wasteland and Ghost Quarter. It also aims to create a powerful token with Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage combo, while slowing down opponents with Sphere of Resistance and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale. The deck also has additional utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Maze of Ith, and various ways to tutor for specific lands like Expedition Map and Crop Rotation. Overall, the deck excels at resource management and control through its land interactions.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively pressure the opponent with a mix of creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Amped Raptor, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah serves as a powerful threat and finisher, while cards like Goblin Bombardment and Swords to Plowshares provide additional removal and reach. The deck also incorporates land destruction with Wasteland and disruption with Karakas to slow down the opponent's mana development. The deck aims to close out the game quickly and efficiently through a combination of creature damage and disruption.

Utilizing fast mana and powerful reanimation spells, this deck aims to quickly cheat big creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into play, overwhelming opponents with their powerful abilities. Through cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead, along with cards like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan, this deck seeks to win the game through powerful combos and efficient resource management. With access to a variety of threats and disruptive spells, this deck can quickly close out games and outmaneuver opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck aims to control the game through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes a variety of disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also generating incremental advantage through cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Assassin's Trophy to deal with threats on the board. With a mix of disruption, card advantage, and removal, this deck seeks to outlast its opponent and eventually win the game through attrition.

The main focus of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Spell Pierce, the deck aims to control the game and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan effectively. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler helps to further disrupt the opponent by limiting their ability to interact on their turn. The deck also includes threats like Murktide Regent and Monastery Mentor to apply pressure and close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted.

The focus of this deck is to play aggressive creatures with disruptive abilities, such as Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, while utilizing mana acceleration like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox to cast them quickly. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Chalice of the Void and Wasteland, limiting the opponent's options, and pressuring the opponent with powerful creatures like Clarion Conqueror. By using cards like Karakas and Sheltered by Ghosts, the deck can protect its key creatures and maintain board advantage to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly disrupt your opponent's strategy while developing your own board presence. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Wasteland to disrupt your opponent's plans, as well as creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Recruiter of the Guard to search for key pieces, you can put pressure on your opponent and control the game. This deck aims to be proactive and aggressive, using its creatures and disruptive spells to keep your opponent off balance and ultimately secure victory in a quick and efficient manner.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. The deck focuses on quickly developing a strong board presence, using cards like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls to apply pressure. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben disrupts the opponent's strategy, while Goblin Bombardment provides additional reach. Swords to Plowshares and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah offer removal options, and Erode can help clear the way for attacks. The mana base includes lands like Wasteland and Sunbaked Canyon to support the deck's aggressive gameplan.

This deck focuses on using Mystic Forge along with artifact mana acceleration and various key cards to generate significant value and potential game-winning combos. The deck aims to quickly ramp up mana, assemble the Mystic Forge combo pieces, and utilize its ability to cast non-land cards from the top of the library to create explosive and overwhelming board states. The inclusion of powerful artifacts like Grim Monolith and Urza's Saga help to further enable the combo strategy and provide additional utility.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating incremental advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat that can quickly close out the game. Pheila, Exuberant Shepherd and Quantum Riddler provide additional card advantage and utility. The mana base is designed to support the deck's main strategy and ensure consistency. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents with a combination of disruption and card advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with efficient stats and abilities to create a fast paced aggressive strategy. The deck includes powerful creatures like Amped Raptor and Orcish Bowmasters that can put pressure on opponents early in the game. Removal spells such as Swords to Plowshares and Cabal Therapy help to clear the way for attacks. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional value and flexibility. Additionally, the deck features a mix of lands that support the aggressive game plan while disrupting the opponent's resources with cards like Wasteland.
